text:
maya: Kicking off rolling deploy for llm-router v2.4.0 in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window. Plan: canary (internal) -> prod 5% soak (15m) -> 20% (30m) -> 60% next window. Feature flag `llmroute_split` will be toggled per cohort. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.4.0 :rocket; will update after soak.

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy queued service=llm-router version=v2.4.0 by maya. Canary -> prod. Manual approvals required at each ramp.

aaron: Holdpoint: keep 5% for full 15m. Gating: p99 < 400ms, total 5xx < 0.5% and queue depth steady. If p99 > 500ms OR 5xx > 1% within soak -> rollback.

maya: noted @aaron 1. Starting internal canary now. Model pinned in manifest: `model_pin = \"v2.4.0-beta\"` so canary traffic hits the new shard. We'll unpin in 24h if stable.

devex-bot: Reminder: attach short user-facing blurb to release notes and include fallback behavior. Suggested line: "Gradual rollout of LLm routing optimization; automatic fallbacks to model v2.3 if errors detected."

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_split` set -> 5% prod cohorts (internal override 100%) by maya. Scheduled ramp actions queued: ->20% at +45m, ->60% at next window.

leah: smoke after 6m: chat and embeddings flows OK, minor latency change +9ms. p99 = 360ms, 5xx = 0.22%. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: watching infra. Observed a transient spike in request queues on gpu-pool-2 at canary start (queue depth +18%). No 5xx. Setting runbook rollback triggers: p99 > 600ms OR 5xx rate > 0.8% for 3 consecutive mins => auto-disable flag and pin back to stable. Disable command via CLI or Console: ```/deploybot flag disable llmroute_split``` or https://redwood.internal/flags/llmroute_split

aaron: ack. Also note: if we hit queue pressure, prefer throttling ingress at edge (rate-limit key) before disabling flag unless errors spike.

maya: manual /approve to ramp to 20% at +45m if gates hold.

deploy-bot: Scheduled action requires manual approval: ramp `llmroute_split` -> 20% at 45m.

maya: /approve ramp to 20% (manual ack).

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_split` -> 20% by maya.

leah: post-ramp (5m): p99 = 390ms, 5xx = 0.4%, queue depth trending down. Noted slightly higher memory on route workers but within alerts.

aaron: good. Plan to hold 20% until end of change window and then decide on next 60% rollout in morning window. Add note to release notes about pin and rollback policy.

maya: update: release notes updated and changelog pinned. Will spin up follow-up thread for next-window ramp. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
